# Razer Naga Pro, our unit. Raw 90-byte feature reports (report ID omitted).
#
# Captured 2026-10-28 with `chimerazer read` (M1, read-only), Ubuntu 26.10,
# kernel 7.3, hid-generic. Wired 1532:008F with the cable in; receiver
# 1532:0090 with the cable out. Source ID: chimerazer-m1-reads.
# No unit identifiers: in `00:82` (serial number) every non-zero serial byte
# is replaced with 'X' (0x58) and the CRC recomputed; everything else is raw.
# The second batch (2026-10-29) adds all remaining read commands.
#
# Format: `frame <pid> <CC:II>` followed by the request (`>`) and the
# response that answered it (`<`).
